description: All-in-one context for starting a dev task: execution paths, tests, entry points, adapted by task type. Use as your FIRST call when beginning any new task — replaces manual chaining of search → get_symbol → Read. For narrower feature-code lookup use get_feature_context instead. Read-only. Returns JSON (default) or Markdown.

detail_level.description: Output verbosity. "minimal" saves ~40-60% tokens (drops scores, fqn, signatures, summaries). Use to pick a candidate before get_symbol. Default: "default".

focus.description: Context strategy: minimal (fast, essential only), broad (default, wide net), deep (follow full execution chains)

output_format.description: "json" (default, structured fields) or "markdown" (single LLM-optimized document with code fences, ~15-20% cheaper).

task.description: Natural language description of the task

name: get_task_context
